propositions: A disposition-closed child (duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated with a live replacement link) is exempt from the completion-verifier gate during close but the certification path demands an attestation anyway, blocking parent certification

The close path grants disposition-closed tickets an exemption at transition_close.py:253-260 but child_closure_findings at llm/completion.py:170-199 applies no such exemption, creating an uncertified state with no honest escape
Deleting the duplicates link or misrepresenting the close class are the only ways to certify an honestly-linked duplicate, making the gate semantics inconsistent across close and certification paths
The completion-verifier attestation for a disposition close must record the disposition class and replacement ticket ID rather than claiming a completion PASS that never occurred
A disposition close that carries a live replacement link should forward certification through that link rather than forfeit it by unsigned treatment
